description: A bearded man in a jewelled crown and red and gold robes sits on a large round silver shield, held up by armoured soldiers in mail and helmets, while a second man in a gold cloak stands behind him. A crowd of spearmen, torch-bearers and clergy in black and gold fills a stone courtyard under a dark sky, with a small boy in a purple gold-trimmed robe standing at right. The architecture shows domes and arched stone walls, and the whole scene is an oil-style painting edge to edge with no visible text or frame.
